note: City of Burlington park on 46 acres along the Neosho River and Rock Creek, a few blocks south of the City Dam; also the Coffey County fair site (Kelley Hall, 4-H building, rodeo arena, stadium). Sites 1-38 along the creek and river have electric only; sites 39-48, just inside the stone-pillar entrance, add water. --Claude
summary: City page + its camping sheet: FCFS self-pay $10/night, no reservations, 14-day limit, 20/30/50-amp electric (water only at sites 39-48), showers and dump. The stored '~8 sites with electric and water' were Drake Park's (the other city campground): count 8 (derived) cleared. Added electric 50, booking (FCFS, max 14), fees note. Not waterfront kept with a riverview lead.
flags: SITES: the stored count 8 (derived) and the note's '~8 sites with electric and water, showers' describe Drake Park/City Dam (8 water+electric stalls), not Kelley Park. Kelley's sheet heads '28 Campsites' but numbers them #1-48 (20 + 18 + 10), so I cleared the count rather than pick one.

LEAD: Drake Park / Burlington City Dam (city campground, 8 concrete water+electric 20/30-amp stalls by the dam on the Neosho, showers, dump, $10 self-pay, east edge of Burlington) is a separate city campground on the same page. Is it in the DB? If not, it is a candidate under the curation rules.
FAIR: Kelley Park hosts the annual Coffey County fair; the city says nothing about campsites during fair week. Probably taken or closed then - untested.
FEES: the $10 rate is dated 'effective April 2016' but is the city's live posted rate (page read 2026-11-05).

WATERFRONT not waterfront kept, lead to riverview: the sheet puts sites 1-38 'along Rock Creek and Neosho River'. Imagery shows a gravel road with posts (likely pedestals) along the Neosho separated from the ~30-40 m channel by a 20-40 m wooded bank; pads can't be placed, and no official photo seen. Not enough to upgrade.

PIN fine: 38.18906,-95.73718 is the west entrance, where sites 39-48 sit 'just inside the stone pillar entrance'. PHONE 620-364-5334 is City Hall (Parks Dept 620-364-3071 for campsite problems). WEBSITE correct. SAND: none.
